data.jd_text:
**Head of Growth \& Performance Marketing** 




**Location: Dubai, UAE** 




  





 A HealthTech company in Dubai needs someone to own patient growth at the highest level. Not manage campaigns. Own the entire engine.
 



  





 The foundations are there across paid social, search, SEO, CRM, and a contact centre already running. What's missing is the leader who sets the vision, holds the P\&L, and builds a world\-class growth function that directly impacts clinical outcomes.
 



  





 You report to the Founders. You own the number.
 



  





**What You'll Focus On** 



* Define and execute the long\-term growth roadmap; translate the founder's vision into a data\-driven acquisition strategy across paid, organic, partnerships, and brand.
* Lead and scale the Growth Marketing team, BD function, and Patient Contact Centre with direct management accountability.
* Own the performance marketing budget end\-to\-end; full accountability for CAC, LTV, ROAS, and top\-line revenue.
* Own Lead to Booked Appointment conversion; CRM and omnichannel nurture across SMS, WhatsApp, and call; sub\-5\-minute speed\-to\-lead; 25–40% Lead\-to\-Booking benchmark.
* Drive appointment show rates above 85% through structured outbound confirmation and re\-engagement workflows.
* Identify and close strategic partnerships across insurance, corporate wellness, and fitness to diversify acquisition beyond paid channels.
* Lead implementation of first\-party data infrastructure, including Server\-Side Tracking and Meta CAPI.
* Deliver high\-cadence performance reporting to the Board in clear commercial language: EBITDA impact, unit economics, market share.
* Ensure all campaigns comply with UAE healthcare advertising standards.



  





**Who You Are** 



* 8–12 years in growth or performance marketing; at least 3 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record driving patient acquisition in healthcare, clinics, or HealthTech within the UAE or GCC.
* Managed multi\-million dirham budgets with direct accountability to Founders or Boards.
* Architect or power user of Meta CAPI, Google PMax, TikTok Ads Manager, GA4, Salesforce or HubSpot, and Tableau or Mixpanel.
* Experience leading or transforming a Contact Centre, Sales, or Patient Services team.
* Thinks in unit economics; revenue, margins, and LTV, not impressions.
* Moves without being told; proactively identifies gaps before they become problems.



  





**Why You'll Thrive Here** 



* Real budget, a team already in place, and the autonomy to build something world\-class.
* Direct line of sight from your decisions to patient outcomes.
* A seat at the table with Founders who empower and get out of the way.
* One of the most competitive and fast\-moving healthcare markets in the world.

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

data.jd_text:
**Investment Director \- Doha, Qatar** 




**The platform** 
 A Doha based alternative investment platform. This vertical is a six\-person investment team spanning education (GCC), infrastructure and secondaries (both global), plus opportunistic deals in other sectors.
 



  





 The teams strategy combines direct minority equity and co\-investments alongside leading global sponsors, with target deployment of c.$1bn per annum across the team.
 



  





 The portfolio shows both breadth and sponsor quality:
 


* **Direct:** 
 a GCC K\-12 schools portfolio and a global lifestyle hospitality platform.
* **Co\-investments:** 
 a global branded consumer business, a US mid\-market alternative asset manager, and a premium European education group.
* **Secondaries / continuation vehicles:** 
 core infrastructure including a major UK airport and a global subsea telecoms network.



  





**The role** 
 A senior, mandate\-shaping hire to lead the firm's education investing, focused on the GCC and building on an established K\-12 schools platform. The Director will own education deals end\-to\-end while contributing to the team's wider direct and co\-investment activity, operating with significant autonomy alongside senior leadership and external sponsors.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Originate and screen GCC education opportunities, with a focus on K\-12 and premium/international schools.
* Execute deals end\-to\-end: modelling, valuation, due diligence, structuring, negotiation and documentation.
* Structure direct minority equity and co\-investments alongside global sponsors.
* Prepare and present investment committee materials.
* Steward portfolio assets: board engagement, performance monitoring, value creation and exit.
* Support the team's wider direct, co\-investment and secondaries activity across infrastructure and other sectors.



  





**Requirements** 



* Director / Principal\-level investment experience from a PE firm, infrastructure or real\-assets fund, sovereign or institutional investor, or sector\-focused education investor.
* Education\-sector experience, ideally schools platforms (K\-12 / international / premium); GCC or emerging\-markets exposure advantageous.
* Strong end\-to\-end execution across direct equity and co\-investments, including structuring and negotiation.
* Excellent commercial judgement, with the ability to lead diligence and present to an IC.
* Relationships across the education ecosystem (sponsors, operators, advisors) a strong plus.
* Familiarity with Shari'a\-compliant structures beneficial but not essential; English fluency required, Arabic an advantage.



  





**Location** 
 Doha, Qatar. Relocation support available.

data.jd_text:
The Funding and Capital Structure Director is a strategic leadership role responsible for managing the Group’s capital structure and executing complex funding and treasury initiatives. The role ensures optimal balance between debt and equity, drives cost\-efficient financing solutions, and oversees capital transactions across projects, acquisitions, and corporate initiatives.
 



 The position requires strong leadership, deep expertise in structured finance, and the ability to manage high\-value funding transactions in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Capital Structure \& Strategy** 



* Lead the development and execution of the Group’s capital structure strategy, ensuring an optimal balance between debt and equity.
* Contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing cost of capital and strengthening financial stability.
* Assess and recommend strategic financing options for Group investments, projects, and acquisitions.



**Funding \& Transactions** 



* Lead end\-to\-end funding processes including debt and equity financing transactions.
* Prepare and review key financing documents such as teasers, term sheets, and financial models.
* Oversee execution of debt issuances, refinancing, restructuring, and equity raising activities.
* Ensure timely completion of all conditions precedent (CPs) and closing requirements for financing deals.



**Debt Portfolio Management** 



* Manage and optimize the Group’s debt portfolio, including refinancing, reprofiling, and restructuring opportunities.
* Identify efficiencies to improve funding terms and overall cost of debt.



**Treasury Projects \& Execution** 



* Lead treasury\-related capital projects ensuring delivery within timelines and budget.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to track progress, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure successful execution of funding initiatives.



**Financial Analysis \& Risk** 



* Develop advanced financial models to evaluate funding structures and scenarios.
* Conduct risk assessments for financing options and capital allocation decisions.



**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team responsible for capital transactions and treasury execution.
* Engage with banks, investors, and advisors to secure optimal financing arrangements.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, strategy, and project teams.



  





**Job Knowledge \& Skills** 



* Strong expertise in debt and equity financing structures.
* Proven experience in debt restructuring, reprofiling, and capital optimization.
* Advanced financial modelling and valuation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of transaction execution and closing processes.
* Proficiency in financial systems and tools (SAP preferred).
* Strong risk management and cost optimization capabilities.
* AI and digital finance fluency is an advantage.



  





**Experience Requirements** 




  




* Minimum
 **20 years of professional experience** 
 in finance or treasury functions.
* At least
 **15 years in leadership or senior management roles** 
 .
* Minimum
 **5 years GCC experience preferred** 
 .



  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
* Professional certification preferred (e.g., ACCA or equivalent).



  





**Core Competencies** 




  




* Leadership \& team development
* Financial control \& risk management
* Strategic thinking \& agility
* Cost optimization

* Execution speed \& delivery focus

data.jd_text:
Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.
   

  

 Mandarin Oriental is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.
   

  

 Mandarin Oriental Al Faisaliah Riyadh– Located in the heart of the city and setting new standards for luxury, Al Faisaliah Hotel is one of the most sought\-after addresses in Saudi Arabia. Its timeless elegance, central location and panoramic views are complemented by Mandarin Oriental’s signature service to ensure a truly unforgettable Arabian experience.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Based at the Mandarin Oriental Al Faisaliah Riyadh within the Engineering Department in Riyadh, the Director of Engineering is responsible for the overall Engineering operation and facility management in compliance with all relevant local codes and regulations, as well as Policy \& Procedures and the Safe, Sound \& Sustainable by Mandarin Oriental manual.
   

  

**As Director of Engineering, you will be responsible for the following duties:**
* It is part of your role to understand and disseminate/communicate all corporate and hotel Policies \& Procedures, Standard Operating Procedures and Human Resources Policy to the colleagues.
* MOHG Code of Conduct requires that all business activities and business decisions comply with the general law, and with all rules, regulations and other requirements.
* Mandarin Oriental, Al Faisaliah Hotel Riyadh has zero tolerance on all forms of harassment or discrimination, i.e. it is strictly forbidden to discriminate on the basis of gender, disability, including physical or medical condition, race, colour, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, marital status, or for any other reason.
* Act as a hotel ambassador at all times.
* Establish engineering guidelines, policies \& procedures and standard operating procedures to maintain excellent standards of quality and reliability in the hotel.
* Establish a monthly reporting system in order to monitor Key Performance Indicators, guest room maintenance, energy consumption, operational and energy expenses, project updates, LQE activities and other specific tasks.
* Prepare annual and Five\-Year capital plan.
* Manage all CAPEX and POMEC projects in accordance with the group policies and procedures.


**As Director Of Engineering, We Expect From You**
* Recruitment and selection of qualified technicians and engineers.
* Telecommunication system upgrades or enhancements.
* Assist in annual maintenance of the contingency systems that support IT\&T equipment and systems.
* Monitor and prepare forecasts on the hotels POMEC expenses.
* Prepare a summary and analysis of the annual POMEC budget.
* Prepare annual POMEC budgets.
* Ensures that engineering colleague’s performance is monitored and that individual career development programs are developed.
* Monitor and lead labour cost management.


**Our commitment to you**
* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Heath \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
* Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.


**Benefits**
* A competitive salary.
* A competitive incentive.
* VIP Health insurance.


**We’re Fans. Are you?**

data.jd_text:
Leading private university in Kuwait is currently recruiting full\-time faculty members as Lab Instructors for its Information Systems \& Technology Program to start from Fall Semester 2026\.
 



  





 Being an equal opportunity employer, it offers internationally competitive salaries, remuneration packages, research incentives, and professional development opportunities.
 



  





 With faculty members and staff coming from more than 60 countries, it is a diverse and inclusive environment. Its campus provides cutting\-edge facilities that faculty and staff can benefit from such as Sports Center, Library, Research and Innovation Center, Cultural Center, and more than 55 laboratories.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 




  





 • A Master’s Degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or any other related field from an internationally accredited university.
 



 • Ability to work in a diverse, interdisciplinary, and fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Have demonstrable skills in oral and written English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 Faculty members are engaged in teaching, services, research and professional development tasks.
 



 Successful candidates are expected to:
 



  





 • Have a strong commitment to teaching excellence.
 



 • Prepare teaching materials, maintain and improve competence in subjects being taught.
 



 • Develop and deliver courses to students.
 



 • Prepare class activities, quizzes, assessments and exams.
 



 • Passionately support the departmental and college\-wide activities and services with a spirit of leadership, commitment, accountability, and collegiality.
 



 • Evaluate, monitor and mentor students' academic progress.
 



 • Supervise and assist students in all aspects related to the courses.
 



 • Guide, lead and mentor students in projects
 



 • Engage actively in promoting the growth of the college and participate in strategic activities and events.
 



 • Participate in departmental and college meetings and activities.
 



 • Serve and support functional activities of departmental committees.
 



 • Undertake any other duties as may be directed by the Head of Department.

data.jd_text: Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Marketing this role will be responsible for defining, owning, and activating the bank’s customer segmentation framework and translating deep customer insight into differentiated, commercially impactful value propositions. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data \& analytics, product, and CX, and plays a critical role in driving growth, retention, and customer lifetime value across priority segments. The role will lead the development of needs\-based segmentation, oversee proposition design and lifecycle management, and ensure propositions are consistently embedded across products, channels, and journeys.
